title: Hastings Old Town Cider Festival
summary: A celebration of apples, cider, producers, food and music. It is fun for all the family, with a chance to meet cider producers and taste the best local and national cider, perry and apple juice.

title: Bettany Hughes: Uncovering Ancient Egypt
summary: DLWP and Fane present Bettany Hughes, 'Uncovering Ancient Egypt', on Wednesday 11 November. Tickets from £32.

title: B.A.B.S Awards Opening Night
venue: The St Leonard pub, London Road, Silverhill
summary: Opening night of this year's B.A.B.S Awards exhibition, themed 'All You Need Is Love', with work by 39 local artists on show at the pub until 31 January 2027.

title: Rye Bonfire
summary: A torch-lit procession leaves Tilling Green and moves through the town, ending with a big bonfire on the Salts and fireworks, including a giant fire-breathing dragon called Scorch.

title: Alabama 3 Acoustic with Drum Club's Lol Hammond
venue: St Leonard's Church, Pevensey Road, St Leonards
summary: Alabama 3 performs an acoustic show in the church, joined by a DJ set from Lol Hammond of Drum Club; tickets from Ticketpass.

title: Robertsbridge Bonfire
summary: The town's procession moves through the High Street to end at the recreation ground, where a giant bonfire is lit and fireworks follow.
